Latin word

occupō

occupō, occupāre, occupāvī, occupātum

verb, first conjugation

take up, occupy (time, a person); seize, take possession of, occupy

    the recommended word · classical · Cael. ap. Cic. Fam. 8.10.3: haec causa prīmōs mēnsēs occupābit (Lewis & Short); Traupman 353

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Agr. 2.75: tōtam Ītaliam suīs praesidiīs obsidēre atque occupāre (Lewis & Short); Hor. C. 1.14.2: occupā portum
